questions.question: In a family, Mr. and Mrs. Gajanan have five daughters and each daughter has one brother. How many persons are there in the family?
questions.solution:
Given:

 Mr. and Mrs. Gajanan (+ 2) has five daughters (+ 5) and each daughter has one brother.

Each daughter has one brother this means if there is a boy in the family he will be the brother of all sister. So there is one brother (+ 1)

Adding all of them;

2 + 5 + 1 = 8

There are **8** people in the family.
